name: Intarabus

attributes.attribute: an obscure Continental Celtic god known from inscriptions in Germany and Belgium
identified by the Romans with their warrior god Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Intarabus is a Continental Celtic god. He is an obscure figure. The meaning of his name cannot be determined. Several inscriptions from Germany and Belgium record him. The Romans identified him with their own warrior god Mars. The link suggests a connection with war, or with the defense of land.

okr.objective: Document the Continental Celtic god Intarabus.
key_results: Record Intarabus as an obscure god known from German and Belgian inscriptions.
Note the Roman identification with the warrior god Mars.
